name: artist-radar
description: Discover emerging music artists before they blow up and get alerted when they announce US tours.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
